status: Released for printing as a fit set: five numbered clamp U sizes and one bar that fits them all, to print together and keep the U that fits the tube. Adds to US-NECK-MOUNT-R008, which stays current.
approval: On 2026-11-03 the user asked for a few numbered clamp options to print at once and pick from (relayed by the coordinator).
relation_to_r008: R008 enclosure back and Pi carrier fit every U: each U has the R008 dovetail tongue (4549.288 mm3, same as the R008 U). The bar has R008 screw positions and width; U 4 has the R008 pocket.

source.image: clamp_set.py shot and part_titles.py, run generated/ultraskelly/clamp-set/r001
source.commit: The commit that adds this checkpoint.

sizing.fit_window: each U fits tubes 0.3 to 0.9 mm narrower than its pocket (0.15 to 0.45 mm per side)

clamp-u-1.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as laid out on the plate.

clamp-u-2.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as laid out on the plate.

clamp-u-3.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as laid out on the plate.

clamp-u-4.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as laid out on the plate.

clamp-u-5.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as laid out on the plate.

clamp-bar-1-5.stl.fits: every U in this set and the R008 U
clamp-bar-1-5.stl.orientation: Flat, number and screw-head recesses up; as laid out on the plate.

plate.check: Plate STL holds all six bodies; each 3MF object matches its part STL within 1e-5 mm.

image.note: Numbers are drawn dark; printed, they are 0.6 mm recesses.

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1.

hardware_for_the_kept_U: 4 x M3 x 16 mm socket-head screw
4 x M3 hex nut, 5.5 mm across flats
lock pin and the rest as in US-NECK-MOUNT-R008

design_guidance.rule: Printers are accurate to about 0.2 mm; moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance.
design_guidance.change: Pockets 0.3 mm apart; each U covers 0.15 to 0.45 mm of play per side.

design_guidance.rule: Printed holes and pockets come out undersized.
design_guidance.change: Two U sizes cover every tube width; a U may fit tighter than its table range.

design_guidance.rule: Walls thinner than one perimeter do not print; strength comes from perimeters.
design_guidance.change: At least 1.45 mm (three perimeters) between every nut slot and the pocket.

design_guidance.rule: Walls over 0.8 mm print on any printer.
design_guidance.change: Number strokes about 1.3 mm; numbers sunk 0.6 mm into upward faces.

not_covered_by_sources: crush ribs (none made: the clamp grips front to back, so side play affects feel only)
text height for engraved numbers beyond the minimum feature size
not_established: which size fits the real tube and how each fit feels
print time and filament: estimated, not sliced
